The condition reads a property of process.env, so env_var fits (s20).

The fallback catch calls downloadBinary and then checkVersion, which calls the exported helper.execute binding with --version (f1:330–331, f1:296–297, f2:12). The awaiter invokes its generator and the Promise executor reaches execFile when live is absent (f2:2–9, f2:265–315).
execute is exported directly and its non-live path reaches the same execFile sink without the install-script guards (f2:12, f2:265–315).

childProcess is bound to node:child_process, and execFile runs the binary returned by getPath (f2:24, f2:315). The installer writes the downloaded binary to the fallback path and getBinaryPath can return that path (f1:190, f1:292, f2:133–136).

The cited guards require download enabled, a supported OS/architecture distribution, failed dependency resolution, and checksum validation enabled (f1:305–330, f1:287, f2:51–104). Darwin needs no architecture condition, giving the stated minimum of four conditions.
The validation flag enables the checksum-validation call and its mismatch deletion, rather than choosing another deletion target or alternate payload (f1:287–288, f1:175–180).
The conditions activate fallback installation on supported systems and enable checksum checking; they do not inspect analysis or sandbox indicators (f1:305–330, f1:287, f2:51–104).

The combined gate mixes platform compatibility, missing optional dependencies, and a checksum-validation override; deletion handles a checksum mismatch (f2:51–104, f1:317–330, f1:175–180). No single listed purpose describes that whole integrity-validation gate better than unclear.

The guarded fallback call reaches downloadBinary, whose validation-enabled branch calls validateChecksum (f1:330, s30, s32). That definition deletes the temporary file on a checksum mismatch (s33, s31), and the earlier process exit and unsupported-platform throw prevent reaching the caller.

validateChecksum has a single call, inside the validation-enabled branch, and downloadBinary has a single caller in the guarded fallback catch (f1:288, f1:330). Neither function is exported in the supplied files, so the specific mismatch-deletion sink has no alternate entry.
fs is imported from fs and the cited sink calls fs.unlinkSync(tempPath), deleting the temporary download on checksum mismatch (f1:5, f1:177–180).
